sections.title: Build websites and operational workflows
sections.body: Use the visual page builder to create and publish your website, add forms and image uploads, and give each project a hosted public address. Incoming submissions flow into response management and data tools, while reservations can be organized through requests, schedules, calendars, and an archive.

sections.title: Run your online store from one dashboard
sections.body: Create products and organize them with categories, brands, and tags. Customize the storefront theme and landing page, connect social links, configure delivery, process orders, and manage loyalty features without separating your catalog from the rest of your operation.

sections.title: Create a complete learning experience
sections.body: Build courses from sections and lessons, manage students, groups, instructors, and learning plans, and give learners a dedicated place to continue their work. Track progress and outcomes, support assessments and certificates, and publish an academy landing experience from the same platform.

about.closing: Whether you are digitizing a service, launching a storefront, or building an academy, Madar keeps what your audience sees connected to the tools your team uses every day.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Madar collects the information needed to provide accounts, tenant workspaces, website builder features, contact forms, and support workflows.

sections.title: Information we process
sections.body: Account details may include name, email, phone, tenant profile data, website settings, uploaded assets, form submissions, billing selections, and operational logs such as IP address and user agent.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: We use this data to authenticate users, operate tenant workspaces, publish customer sites, process contact and form submissions, secure the service, troubleshoot issues, and respond to support requests.

sections.title: Cookies and security
sections.body: The application uses first-party authentication and CSRF cookies to keep sessions working and protect unsafe requests. Analytics and payment SDK cookies are not currently integrated in the frontend.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body: The application uses Supabase-backed authentication and data services. Public links may open Instagram. Builder images are stored as managed workspace assets when uploaded.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For privacy or security questions, contact info@madar.com.

sections.title: Accounts and security

sections.title: Your content and responsibilities

sections.title: Plans, billing, and third-party services

sections.title: Service availability and changes
sections.body: We may maintain, improve, replace, or discontinue features and may temporarily limit access for security, maintenance, legal, or operational reasons. We will make reasonable efforts to protect service continuity and stored workspace data.

sections.title: Suspension and termination
sections.body: We may restrict or end access when these terms are materially violated, the service is placed at risk, or the law requires it. You may stop using Madar at any time, subject to any active plan or payment obligations.
